g.title: backend_marble_generation
g.text: JavaWiz stream instrumentation and visualization — compile time to frontend

g.title: cluster_compile
g.text: 1 COMPILE TIME — discover independent operation sites

g.title: cluster_jdi
g.text: 3 JDI BRIDGE — convert helper exits into backend events

g.title: cluster_projection
g.text: 4 PROJECTION — turn execution events into marble data

g.title: compiler
g.text: No compile-time stream owns another operation.

g.title: visitor
g.text: Finds source, intermediate, flatMap, and terminal calls.
Visits callback/lambda bodies too. One fixed ID per site.

g.title: operationInfo
g.text: receiver type, parameter and source coordinates

g.title: instrumentation
g.text: Sources get START peeks; intermediates get IN/OUT peeks.
Terminals get completion wrappers; flatMap gets a child wrapper.

g.title: javaWiz
g.text: A first START opens an execution; flatMap pre-opens children.
Completion pops and restores the parent.

g.title: sourceHook
g.text: The first element assigns the execution ID.

g.title: operationHooks
g.text: Terminal wrappers preserve the return value and publish completion data.

g.title: flatMap
g.text: Opens a child before consumption; restores the parent around downstream action.
Exhaustion calls endNestedFlatmapStream, including empty children.

g.title: jdi
g.text: Reads trace arguments and $JavaWiz static fields:
active execution, completed execution, operation, result.

g.title: event
g.text: START, IN, OUT, END/completion, or child exhaustion
with operation ID and active runtime execution ID.

g.title: tracer
g.text: Creates execution at START or completion, activates parent chains,
records events, and rebuilds after completed boundaries.

g.title: execution
g.text: id is the runtime execution ID.
Ordered events and operation indexes are local.

g.title: generator
g.text: Uses first-observed operation order, not adjacent IDs.
Creates lanes, marbles, lineage links, labels,

g.title: data
g.text: including empty executions; each carries parent ID,
